title: 前副国安顾问Mara Rutman：伊朗是非对称战争大师，核协议需严格检查
speaker: Mara Rutman

segments.en: I wonder how does its bottom line sort of shift and how has it shifted amid the war in the way that they were attacked in this manner by the US and Israel as well and does that perhaps encourage them a bit more to just keep these nuclear materials within the country regardless just to keep a bit of ambiguity.
segments.zh: 我想知道它的底线如何变化，在战争期间，当他们受到美国和以色列这样的攻击时，这是否会鼓励他们更倾向于将核材料留在国内，以保持一定的模糊性

segments.en: Yeah well listen they they first of all proved to be masters of asymmetric warfare and should be clear on that the United States through a tremendous amount of resources as to Israel into into setting them back and our military did a quite extraordinary job tactically
segments.zh: 是的，首先他们证明了自己是非对称战争的大师，应该清楚的是，美国投入大量资源帮助以色列打击他们，我们的军队在战术上做得非常出色

segments.en: in terms of what they went and were able to do the administration of raw I would say didn't extraordinarily poor job of one of the basic things you need to understand when you're going to conflict which is what your enemy is likely to do and what's in their heads and how they're likely to react.
segments.zh: 就他们所能做的而言，我认为政府在冲突前需要理解的基本事情上做得非常差，即敌人可能做什么、他们在想什么以及他们可能如何反应

segments.en: And so that's why I say Iran really showed themselves the Iranian regime I should be clear in distinction from Iran as a country or from the Iranian people but showed themselves to be masters of this kind of asymmetric warfare
segments.zh: 所以这就是为什么我说伊朗真正展示了他们自己，伊朗政权（我应明确区分于伊朗国家或伊朗人民）展示了他们是非对称战争的大师

segments.en: and they used a lover that proved to be very powerful some would argue as powerful as having a nuclear weapon which was their ability to control and block traffic going and shipping in and out of the straight-of-form moose which really put the world in an economic gridlock to some degree
segments.zh: 他们使用了一种非常强大的杠杆，有人认为和拥有核武器一样强大，那就是他们控制并阻断霍尔木兹海峡航运的能力，这在一定程度上使世界经济陷入僵局

segments.en: and you know we've all felt the economic repercussions of that and so I see no sign that Iran would be any more willing than they've been in the past to actually halt nuclear activity
segments.zh: 我们都感受到了经济影响，所以我看不到任何迹象表明伊朗会比过去更愿意停止核活动

segments.en: and they have made the commitment multiple times they have no intention of getting a nuclear weapon and I think that has been met with a good degree and a fair degree of skepticism for good reason
segments.zh: 他们多次承诺无意获取核武器，我认为这遭到了相当程度的怀疑，而且理由充分

segments.en: and that is part of why any agreement needs to have quite a rigorous inspection component to it. This won't be easy to get done and 60 days was a very short period of time.
segments.zh: 这就是为什么任何协议都需要非常严格的检查部分。这不容易做到，60天是非常短的时间
